content.what_it_is: A V35/0x24 text-form NVFortran compiler module-interface artifact for mod_cuda, generated from mod_cuda.f90. It exposes FUNWAVE-GPU device storage, CUDA/cuSPARSE/cuTENSOR integration state, launch geometry, wave and hydrodynamic field descriptors, diagnostic interfaces, and extensive opaque compiler serialization records (lines 1-7576).
entities: mod_cuda compiler-interface artifact generated from mod_cuda.f90 (lines 1-2)
Dependencies on nvf_acc_common, CUDA runtime, cuTENSOR types and API, GPU reduction types and routines, sort, cudafor_la, iso_c_binding, cuSPARSE, param, and global (lines 4-16)
Imported CUDA, cuSPARSE, cuTENSOR, ISO C binding, accelerator-runtime, parameter, and global symbol interfaces (lines 17-1200)

GPU runtime state including tridiagonal solver storage, CUDA events and streams, cuSPARSE handle and buffer, kernel launch grids, memory accounting, boundary values, coefficients, and grid spacing (lines 1201-1400)
Device hydrodynamic, reconstruction, derivative, flux, source, mask, bathymetry, mean/statistical, breaking, sponge, and wavemaker field descriptors (lines 1401-2700)
var_d2h_output interface for device-to-host output transfer (lines 2701-2750)
estimate_dt_gpu interface for GPU time-step estimation (lines 2701-2770)
cudadevicequery interface for CUDA device inspection (lines 2701-2780)
cusparse_init and cusparse_destroy interfaces for cuSPARSE lifecycle (lines 2701-2790)
kerneltimeprint interface for kernel timing diagnostics (lines 2701-2800)
check_print, check_print_int, check_outputd, and check_outputh diagnostic interfaces (lines 2701-2820)
Opaque compiler declarations, attributes, array descriptors, cross-references, expression nodes, argument maps, and type tables (lines 2821-7576)
unresolved: The V35/0x24 compiler module format and the meanings of its D/S/R/A/F/J/V/T/X/Z numeric records, flags, offsets, and bit masks are not defined within the artifact, so most numeric metadata and relationships cannot be decoded from this file alone (lines 1, 17-7576).
The timestamp 06/12/2026 does not state whether its date order is month/day or day/month (line 3).
